base_prompt:
FULL-FRAME ILLUSTRATION (not a sprite): a widescreen 16:9 LANDSCAPE image with its own complete background, no transparency. No text, no letters, no captions, no logos, no watermark, no speech bubbles, no UI.
MAIN CHARACTER (must match the attached reference exactly: face, white hair, big full white beard, black sunglasses, red Santa hat with white fur trim, comically over-muscular SHIRTLESS body, red pants with white fur cuffs, black boots). He wears ONLY the red hat, sunglasses, red pants and black boots (no shirt, no jacket, no belt) unless the scene says otherwise.
UNIFIED ART STYLE FOR THE WHOLE IMAGE (very important, all images in this series must look like the same game): draw the BACKGROUND in exactly the same stylized cel-shaded cartoon style as the character in the reference: flat color regions with a single soft shadow tone, clean medium-thick dark navy outlines around the character AND around major background shapes, simplified background shapes. NOT painterly, NOT photorealistic, NOT a glossy 3D render, no heavy bokeh, no lens flare textures, no noisy fine detail. A limited, cheerful, saturated color palette.
Anatomy: exactly two arms, two legs, five fingers per hand, correct proportions. Funny, high-energy and readable. Follow the COMPOSITION instructions of the scene exactly (camera angle, character size and position), because every image in the series must have a clearly DIFFERENT composition from the others.

jobs.name: bg_01_barbell
jobs.prompt: SCENE: a cozy Christmas gym. He lifts a huge barbell overhead whose plates are giant gift boxes. COMPOSITION: LOW-ANGLE close-up (camera near the floor looking up), waist-up, Santa fills the LEFT 45 percent of the frame and is cropped by the left edge, the barbell sweeping across the top toward the right; gym rack and warm lights in the background.

jobs.name: bg_02_sleigh
jobs.prompt: SCENE: a snowy night sky over a village. He holds an entire loaded Santa sleigh overhead with one arm while three surprised reindeer dangle from it. COMPOSITION: EXTREME WIDE SHOT, Santa is TINY (about 12 percent of the frame height) standing in the BOTTOM-RIGHT corner on a rooftop; the giant sleigh and reindeer fill the upper two thirds; huge moon.

jobs.name: bg_03_armwrestle
jobs.prompt: SCENE: a cabin arm-wrestling match against a sweating reindeer. COMPOSITION: SIDE-ON TIGHT CLOSE-UP of the two faces and arms: Santa's big smug face enters from the LEFT edge, the reindeer's strained face from the RIGHT edge, and their locked hands are in the middle-bottom of the frame on a wooden table; only head, shoulders and arms are visible, no legs.

jobs.name: bg_04_tree_squat
jobs.prompt: SCENE: a snowy forest at golden sunset. He does a deep squat with a whole decorated Christmas tree across his shoulders as a barbell. COMPOSITION: seen FROM BEHIND (back view), medium-wide shot, Santa occupies the CENTER-LOWER part of the frame about 55 percent of the frame height, his big back muscles toward us, facing the glowing sunset horizon; snowy pines on both sides.

jobs.name: bg_05_sack
jobs.prompt: SCENE: a snowy rooftop at night. He carries a giant overflowing sack of presents on one shoulder and gives a thumbs-up. COMPOSITION: WORM'S-EYE VIEW from far below, Santa stands at the TOP-RIGHT on a roof edge, seen against a giant full moon and stars, his body foreshortened and heroic, sack hanging over the edge; the bottom-left of the frame shows snowy chimney tops.

jobs.name: bg_06_selfie
jobs.prompt: SCENE: a bright cheerful photo moment with sparkling Christmas lights. COMPOSITION: FIRST-PERSON SELFIE POINT OF VIEW with a slightly tilted camera (dutch angle) and wide-angle feel: his giant smiling face and one hugely flexed arm fill the RIGHT-CENTER of the frame, a smartphone is seen from the back at the left holding the shot; pastel pink and blue background with lights.

jobs.name: bg_07_disco
jobs.prompt: SCENE: a disco dance floor. He strikes a cool deadpan dance pose. COMPOSITION: HIGH-ANGLE TOP-DOWN view looking down onto a huge glowing rainbow-tiled dance floor with a big disco ball hanging at the top; Santa is smallish (about 30 percent of the frame height) at the LOWER-LEFT of the floor with a long shadow, colorful light beams crossing the floor.

jobs.name: bg_08_shaker
jobs.prompt: SCENE: a gym at sunset. He chugs a giant protein shaker full of milk with cookies floating inside, milk dripping down his beard. COMPOSITION: CLOSE-UP of the giant shaker bottle and his upper body, TILTED camera, Santa fills the far RIGHT 50 percent of the frame, the big transparent shaker bottle is the biggest element in the foreground; a huge orange sunset window behind.

jobs.name: bg_09_yeti
jobs.prompt: SCENE: a snowy mountain pass in a blizzard. A funny size-contrast standoff. COMPOSITION: WIDE SHOT from a slightly low angle, a GIANT white yeti looms over the RIGHT and center, towering over everything (about 90 percent of the frame height) flexing its arms, while TINY Santa (about 25 percent of the frame height) stands at the BOTTOM-LEFT flexing back with confidence, looking up at the yeti.

jobs.name: bg_10_snowman_hide
jobs.prompt: SCENE: a snowy yard in front of a cozy cabin at night. He tries to hide behind a tiny snowman while wearing a small blue knitted kid's beanie with a yellow pom-pom (NO Santa hat in this scene), his huge muscular body obviously sticking out. COMPOSITION: HIGH-ANGLE view looking down at a slant, Santa and the tiny snowman are in the CENTER-BOTTOM of the frame at medium size, lots of empty snowy ground and footprints around them.

jobs.name: bg_11_peak
jobs.prompt: SCENE: the summit of a snowy mountain at sunrise with a green and purple aurora across the sky. COMPOSITION: seen FROM BEHIND, wide shot, Santa stands at the BOTTOM-CENTER on the peak with both arms spread wide, small-to-medium size (about 35 percent of the frame height), his white beard blown sideways by the wind, the vast glowing sky takes up most of the frame.

jobs.name: bg_12_hottub
jobs.prompt: SCENE: a steaming wooden hot tub in a snowy yard at night, fairy lights, snowy pines. He relaxes in the water up to his chest holding a mug of hot cocoa, smug smile, hat and sunglasses on. COMPOSITION: TOP-DOWN AERIAL view directly above the round hot tub, which is at the CENTER-LEFT of the frame, Santa seen from above leaning back, looking up at the camera and raising his mug; steam swirls, snow all around.
